# Records

<!-- Generated by `mustur export`. Do not hand-edit: `mustur verify` fails on drift, and the store is the record. -->

Mustur's own records, exported from its store. The store is the record; this tree is the audit surface and the backup, and it is what a reader who does not run the binary can check.
